subject: [PATCH v3 3/3] nfsd: compare CB_GETATTR times against the inode

2026-09-04.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFS server's delegation handling to compare client-reported timestamps against the actual inode times, rather than stale values. This change prevents clients from moving the inode's timestamp backwards by updating it after a previous setattr operation. The patch also removes unnecessary fields from the delegation structure and fixes a bug where an uninitialized struct kstat was being read.
